verdict.rationale: Pipecat is a developer framework and cloud platform. Shipping a built-in assistant that users can hand tasks to is plausible for this kind of product, so the axis applies, but the evidence documents none. The context-hub MCP server and the scaffolded AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md files support the user's own external coding agent, not an assistant inside Pipecat. Subagent handoff and Flows are building blocks for constructing the user's own bots, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
